title: Confidence Band Compression Watch
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast
| eval confidence_band=case(confidence<40,"0-39",confidence<60,"40-59",confidence<80,"60-79",1=1,"80-100")
| stats count as forecasts by confidence_band
| sort - forecasts
description: Shows whether your probability forecasts are using a healthy range of confidence or clustering too tightly.
value: Forecasters who only use a narrow confidence band often fail to express genuine uncertainty.
implementation: Classify forecast confidence into broad bands and count how often each band is used.
visualization: Bar chart of forecast counts by confidence band.
grandmaExplanation: It warns whether you are using a wide enough range of confidence instead of bunching everything together.
